List all schedule resources.

## Synopsis

```text
.schedule [enabled | disabled]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Prints the names of all Schedule resources of the Director configuration, one per line, for selection lists such as enabling or disabling a schedule. Only schedules allowed by the console's Schedule ACL appear. enabled or disabled filter by state; a value after the keyword is ignored and both together give an empty list.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | keyword |  |  | one of: state | Only enabled resources. |
| `disabled` | keyword |  |  | one of: state | Only disabled resources. |

## Examples

List all visible schedules:

```text
.schedule
```

List only disabled schedules:

```text
.schedule disabled
```
